measurement.method: Temporary vitest file (deleted after use) with the mansion dataset rewritten in memory per variant; rows from p4AdapterBaselineRows activityRows/eventRows over 1098 dates. Run under the production config (shipped manifest + P4 provider) and under the flag-OFF baseline-v1 mock; flag-OFF variant A reproduced the locked baseline v1 byte-for-byte.
limits: Only TSV columns (score, status, hard_warning / score, classification) and the row sha256 were compared, not every record leaf. A full-leaf comparison is a gate for the implementation phase.

In variants B and C the moved quotes resolve as interpretation_pending because their terms are not terms of the target scope; a real implementation adds terms/reviewTerm and keeps golden v2 all-reviewed.
Renovation figures are an estimate: they assume a remapped renovation scores exactly like groundbreaking (B) or construction (C).
